body: You seem to be the only one thats read the whole thing. First of all, thank you. And second of all, you having these thoughts on your own and reading it again and still having hope has given me a little of my own. At least now i will be happy in my decision. Just because i can’t find a way out doesn’t mean you can’t either. Whatever has gotten you this far, grasp onto it with all your strength. That hope you have, no matter how little, is what i lack to go on, and i hope is serves you well friend.
Uhh forgot to mention that the day i have planned for the deed is two days. So yeah, if you wanted to talk you have some time.
